verdicts.rationale: Survivor gillies2007counterfactual and Gillies2007 (Zotero-style key) share identical title, author, journal, vol 30/no 3, pages 329-360, and DOI. Duplicate import; merge.

gillies2009truthconditions, gillies2008truthconditions, and Gillies2009 all carry the same DOI, title, journal (Phil Review), vol 118/no 3, pages 325-349, year 2009. The '2008' in one citekey is a key artifact; content identical. Same work.
Survivor and Gladziejewski2017 (Zotero key) share identical title, authors, journal, vol 32/no 3, pages 337-355, and DOI. Duplicate; merge.

Survivor is the 1998 incollection reprint in 'Mind Readings' (MIT Press, DOI 10.7551/mitpress/4631.003.0009). glasgow1992computational is the original 1992 Cognitive Science article, vol 16/no 3, pages 355-394, with a DIFFERENT DOI (10.1207/s15516709cog1603_2). Both are independently deepIndexed. Distinct publications; exclude the 1992 article.
Survivor and GodfreySmith2017 (Zotero key) share identical title, author, journal, vol 12/no 4, pages 275-286, and DOI. Duplicate; merge.

goldinmeadow2005resilience, GoldinMeadow2005 (note 'Preprint (forthcoming)'), and goldinmeadow2003aresilience (shadow key) all carry the same DOI, year 2005, publisher Psychology Press, and isbn. Same book; merge.

All five members (goldinmeadow2015gesture, goldinmeadow2017gesture, goldin2017gesture, goldinmeadowbrentari2017gesture, GoldinMeadow2017) share the same DOI, title, authors, journal (BBS), volume 40. Year 2015 vs 2017 reflects online-first vs print-year; the '2017' variants and preprint-noted keys are the same article. Merge.
Survivor golomb2011higher and Golomb2012b (Zotero key) share identical title, authors, journal, vol 22/no 12, pages 2794-2810, and DOI. Year 2011 vs 2012 is online-first vs print. Same work; merge.
Survivor and Golomb2012a (Zotero key) share identical title, authors, journal (PNAS), vol 109/no 5, pages 1796-1801, and DOI. Duplicate; merge.
Survivor and Golomb2014 (Zotero key) share identical title, authors, journal (JEP:General), vol 143/no 6, pages 2262-2278, and DOI. Duplicate; merge.
golomb2018representations, Golomb2018, and golomb2018representa share the same DOI, title, author, venue (CCN 2018), and year. Only bib type differs (article/inproceedings/misc). Same work; merge.

Survivor goodman1968languages (1968 Bobbs-Merrill, deepIndexed, canonical) and goodman1994languages (1994, DOI 10.2307/jj.18254729.34, deepIndexed, has_folder) are two independently-indexed editions with different DOIs and years — exclude the 1994. The remaining edition-variant keys (goodman1976languages, goodman1976, goodman1969languages, goodman1978languages) carry no independent indexing and fold into the survivor as edition shadow keys.
